decisions.text: seen: server/routes/conversations.js (`last` field of GET /) — a template message is stored with text '' and the row carries no template name, so a list row's preview is blank when the newest message is a template; the plan asked for the dictionary body there. Reverse: add `last.template` to the route's answer and render its body.
behaviour: the row preview shows `last.text` only (blank for template messages) — reverse: once the route returns the template name, show its dictionary body.
behaviour: the guest 'button' message shows 'נבחר: {title}' (key chat_button_tapped) with the message text as the title — reverse: show the bare title.
behaviour: a failed re-read of an already open thread (the 10 s refresh) keeps what is shown and logs, with no error screen — reverse: clear the thread on any failure.
behaviour: the window time left is shown as HH:mm (hours:minutes) in ibx_window_open — reverse: change the format in InboxPage.windowLeft_.
behaviour: the reply box's template choice is a one-entry app-custom-select that is display only (need_more_info is always the one sent) — reverse: drop the select.

behaviour: the list rows are plain single-line flex links (.ibx-row), not .c-list-row cells, because .c-list-row is display:contents and needs a grid parent; the plan's list-page default stays an exception — reverse: move rows into app-list-shell.
behaviour: the inbox page's own timers run outside the Angular zone so a repeating timer never keeps the app unstable — reverse: remove the runOutsideAngular wrapper.

behaviour: the client picker filters out test guests with an exported `isTestClient` helper (the same rule as `realClients_`) instead of reading `realClients_`. Specs of other picker hosts (new-inquiry-dialog, event-stage-bar) mock ClientDataService with `allClients_` only and are outside this plan's scope — reverse: read `realClients_` in client-picker.component.ts and add it

behaviour: the phone frame shows nothing while no guest is chosen. The plan names no key for a placeholder, and the guest list already shows `sim_no_guests`. — reverse: add a prompt message in the frame.
